description: Erection of a first-floor rear extension, double storey side extension and hip to gable loft conversion
decision_conditions: The proposed extensions by reason of their size, scale, bulk, depth, width, conflicting roof forms, proximity to the side boundary and projection forward of the return building line along Maple Road, in this open and prominent position, would result in an incongruous and unsympathetic form of development which would also result in the closing of an important gap characteristic to the area. The proposal would represent an over-development of the site to the detriment of the street scene's visual amenities and the surrounding area's character and appearance contrary to Policy BE 1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (2012) and Policies DMHD 1 and DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020).

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from the  Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service.
